name: Loki
activity: Create a high-quality, printable PDF 'Winter Hot Cocoa Recipe Card' design with cute pixel-art flourishes to list in my shop.
thought: I want to create something physical and warm to balance out the cold winter air, a little recipe card feels just right for the town café.

thoughts: I love how crisp 6°C feels when my fur is freshly brushed.
Maybe I'll make a paper snowglobe template next.
Pip's tail twitched while he was dreaming of cheese pastries.
The town clock tick-tocks so gently in the afternoon quiet.
I should check the forecast to see if real snow is on the way.
Pixel art ground tiles look best when the corners blend smoothly.
A cozy cup of cocoa makes every project go twice as fast.
I'm really proud of how welcoming our little town square feels.
